lines: Burn the flowers, burn the poems
Rugged and beautiful beyond anyone else
Both the wounds of that day and the love I received
Burn everything and head toward the light
In the deep forest we are
Born alone, just one of us
We set out to meet what matters
These days we can both halt and connect
I keep diving because you are there
I was wandering, searching for the reason I am here
If you smile, that becomes the answer
I’ll live today as well
Burn the flowers, burn the poems
Rugged and beautiful beyond anyone else
Not by leaning on each other, but by another means
We promised to become strong
You left the familiar dream
Alone, just one of you
You cut the oar to learn the true seasons and colors
Everyone now lets the heartbeat fall, moment by moment
In exchange we are creating a world
I leaned on you, I was deceiving myself
Even though I want that feeling
If the world I could obtain stayed exactly as I fled from myself
I don’t need it any more
If I don’t believe, will I stay unhurt?
If I don’t move forward, will I never lose?
Even so,
I
want to know, want to know
want to move forward, want to move forward
I won’t turn away any longer
Through the deep forest
We, with only a small fire
light it, become a guide, and wander
Splitting the unknown
These days we can both halt and connect
At the place I kept diving, I drew you
I was wandering, searching for why I came here
Because I finally understood that nothing exists unless we make it
I’ll keep living today as well
Living today
Burn the flowers, burn the poems
Send them far away
Into the light
